title: Nvidia Spy Probe: What We Know Now
summary: Bloomberg's Michael Shepard explains why Nvidia is so central to the AI boom, from its chips to its financing of AI cloud providers, and why the probe into Jensen Huang's affair with a suspected Chinese spy unsettles the whole sector. He traces how Huang lobbied Washington to loosen chip-export limits to China against bipartisan opposition, and how reporting on a halted US probe of Singapore-based Megaspeed raises questions about the administration's role. The hosts ask whether rivals such as Google can now gain ground, and Shepard concludes the scandal will weaken Nvidia's influence in Washington.
focus: Shadow the opening explainer on why Nvidia matters to the AI economy and its financing ties, then the later passage on export controls and the bipartisan resistance to selling chips to China.
